timeline.summary: Loot and companions are lured to the Peregrinator Complex by Corsen on the orders of Dreadfang.
timeline.quote: Corsen reveals that his family is being held hostage

citation.text: "Tapestries", section "What's in a Name? , by Michael A. Stackpole". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Loot realizes his new name makes all the loot cursed and lets Dreadfang wield a sword, which kills him.
timeline.quote: Loot lets Dreadfang wield a sword from the stash, and the Crookshank leader immediately swings and stabs himself to death.

citation.text: "Tapestries", section "What's in a Name? , by Michael A. Stackpole". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Loot is framed for Sopti Borth's murder, fights the Justiciar with Kyyrao and the marshal, and exposes Haspian as the killer.
timeline.quote: He learns that the killer is Haspian Chastoril , the forger who built the Justiciar.

citation.text: "Distant Planes", section "Insufficient Evidence , by Michael A. Stackpole". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska seize Loot during the Vault Heist.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren and Vraska seize Loot , the Fomori child that was locked in the vault, and disappear.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Omenpath Era (4562 AR - present)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Loot is captured by Valgavoth at Duskmourn.
timeline.quote: he is captured by Valgavoth .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Omenpath Era (4562 AR - present)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska reunite with the prize, a toddler-like child from the Fomori vault.
timeline.quote: The boy (Tamiyo's text said it was a boy) seems all too happy to take in the world around them.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace reads the child's mind and learns his name is Loot.
timeline.quote: "His name is Loot."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace sees that Loot's mind holds a map of the entire Multiverse and every Omenpath endpoint.
timeline.quote: It's the way to get from every point to every point.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska promise to protect Loot as their ward.
timeline.quote: Vraska and I will protect you with all of our strength.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: The three plan to walk through an Omenpath into the Multiverse, resolved that theirs will be better.
timeline.quote: Ours will be better.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko opens the vault for Jace and Vraska; Jace takes Loot and triggers a collapse, but the team escapes, after which Breeches and Malcolm leave the plane.
timeline.quote: Breeches and Malcolm left the plane.

citation.text: "Breeches", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska escape with Loot as the vault collapses.
timeline.quote: Jace and Vraska disappeared with Loot.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The team secures the key; Jace claims Loot and triggers a collapse; the team escapes.
timeline.quote: Jace revealed himself and secured his prize, a young creature named Loot .

citation.text: "Malcolm Lee", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace opens the vault and claims Loot; Vraska tries to petrify Oko, who escapes.
timeline.quote: Vraska attempted to petrify him, but he escaped

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, disguised as Ashiok, shatters the pod and frees Loot, then disappears with Loot and Vraska.
timeline.quote: He pressed both hands to the glass, and the pod shattered.

citation.text: "Loot", section "Maag Taranau". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska use Loot's mental map to plot a course across the Multiverse, stopping at Bloomburrow among other places.
timeline.quote: With his mental map, they plotted a course across the Multiverse and left Thunder Junction with Loot in tow.

citation.text: "Loot", section "Interplanar travels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Loot wanders through a moth-covered door into Duskmourn; Jace and Vraska are separated and Jace travels briefly with Kaito Shizuki.
timeline.quote: Jace and Vraska followed him to Duskmourn where they quickly became separated.

citation.text: "Loot", section "Interplanar travels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth captures Loot, who is conscripted onto the Speed Demons and caged by captain Winter atop the Last Ride.
timeline.quote: Although Jace went after his family, the demon Valgavoth captured Loot.

citation.text: "Loot", section "Interplanar travels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Saurid raiders capture Loot on Muraganda; he befriends Daretti and Chandra and Pia Nalaar rescue them.
timeline.quote: While they were waiting to be sacrificed, he befriended the goblin Daretti .

citation.text: "Loot", section "Interplanar travels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Back on Avishkar, Jace demands his child back, mind-controls racers, knocks out those who resist and takes Loot, leaving with Vraska for Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Though they attempted to fight back, Jace rendered them unconscious, taking Loot back.

citation.text: "Loot", section "Interplanar travels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Tarkir Vraska notices Loot trying to hide from Jace and tries to dissuade him from keeping Loot in stasis.
timeline.quote: Vraska noted that Loot kept trying to hide from the mind mage

citation.text: "Loot", section "Interplanar travels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace's spell in the Meditation Plane fails and unmakes reality including Jace; Narset picks up Loot as the survivors escape, and he is returned to the grieving Vraska on Tarkir.
timeline.quote: The distressed Loot was picked up by Narset right before the survivors escaped.

citation.text: "Loot", section "Interplanar travels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Vryn, Vraska and Ranna raise Loot and give him a basic education.
timeline.quote: On Vryn, Vraska and Jace's mother Ranna acted as parental figures for Loot, giving him a basic education.

citation.text: "Loot", section "Interplanar travels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska uses Loot's talents to map a way to the Echoverse from Vryn but does not bring him along.
timeline.quote: she used Loot's talents to map a way there from Vryn, but did not bring him along

citation.text: "Loot", section "Interplanar travels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Loot is summoned to fight in a planeswalker duel and left behind when it ends, then loses his memory from a blow to the head.
timeline.quote: Loot was summoned to fight in a planeswalker duel and left behind when it ended

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kyyrao's warriors attack the dazed Loot and are easily beaten; the cat warriors nurse him back to health and Kyyrao takes him for her mate.
timeline.quote: Upon waking, Kyyrao took him for her mate.

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dreadfang lures Loot and his companions to the Peregrinator Complex, using Corsen's family as leverage.
timeline.quote: were lured there by a Crookshank Kobold broodlord named Dreadfang

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "At the Peregrinator Complex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Loot retrieves the armor Dreadfang wanted, since his nameless state should make him immune to the curse.
timeline.quote: Loot did as he was told and retrieved the armor.

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "At the Peregrinator Complex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Realizing his own name is cursed, Loot taunts Dreadfang, who attacks with the cursed sword; it turns on him and impales him.
timeline.quote: The looted sword, now cursed, turned on its user and impaled the kobold.

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "At the Peregrinator Complex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sopti Borth is murdered, and Loot is arrested because the Truthsniffer picked him out.
timeline.quote: Loot was arrested for her murder because a Truthsniffer had picked him out.

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "The Justiciar of Automatown". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malkean orders the Justiciar to seek the guilty and it attacks Loot, who dodges and slams it into a wall.
timeline.quote: Malkean ordered the machine to seek the guilty

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "The Justiciar of Automatown". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Loot reads the cameo with a psychometric spell, tosses it to Kyyrao to find the culprit, and freezes the Justiciar's hydraulic fluid; it falls on Haspian.
timeline.quote: used a spell to freeze its hydraulic fluid

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "The Justiciar of Automatown". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kyyrao beheads the Justiciar and Loot exposes Haspian as the forger who killed Sopti and framed him.
timeline.quote: He killed her and used the scapegoat ritual to sever all links between himself and the evidence so he could frame Loot.

citation.text: "Loot Niptil", section "The Justiciar of Automatown". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth captures Loot.
timeline.quote: he was captured by the demon Valgavoth

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Travels with Loot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace knocks out Chandra and recovers Loot.
timeline.quote: he rendered her unconscious with an overwhelming mental attack, recovering Loot

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Travels with Loot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth, heavily wounded, has nonetheless captured Loot.
timeline.quote: Valgavoth had captured Loot , a creature that could visualize the connections across all the planes of the Multiverse.

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Expansion through Omenpaths". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Loot is captured by the demon Valgavoth in the House.
timeline.quote: Loot was captured by the demon Valgavoth

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Pursuing the plan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace knocks Chandra unconscious to recover Loot.
timeline.quote: he rendered her unconscious, recovering Loot

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Pursuing the plan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A raider's hook tears Loot's cage from Winter's vehicle and drops Loot into a sack.
timeline.quote: Momentum and angles combine to tear the hook free—and the cage along with it.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra abandons the race and jumps onto a dinosaur to rescue Loot.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar jumps from her ride and hitches a ride on one that's more old-fashioned.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti is caged with Loot and introduces himself.
timeline.quote: The name's Daretti.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti shares Fioran chocolate with Loot as they expect to be sacrificed.
timeline.quote: If we're going to be sacrificed the way they say, at least we'll go out like gentlemen

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Loot spots a sneaking Chandra in Cloudspire colors.
timeline.quote: Slinking among the foliage, he sees a slip of orange-red fire

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia picks the cage lock and frees Loot and Daretti.
timeline.quote: And, sure enough, Chandra's mom has the lock figured out all before Daretti has even realized there's anything going on behind him.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra offers Loot a place with Team Cloudspire.
timeline.quote: If you like, you can hang out with me and Team Cloudspire.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra sets off a fireball that blows up half the raiders' camp as they escape.
timeline.quote: As half of the camp explodes, she hops into the ride with the others.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Following Loot's cue, Chandra steers left into a tree whose bark falls away to reveal an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Beneath it, the spiraling light of an Omenpath.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: They crash across the border into a different world.
timeline.quote: A second later, they crash over the border into a different world.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The rocket car spirals out of the Omenpath above an oasis on Amonkhet instead of reaching Avishkar.
timeline.quote: the rocket car spirals into the air above an oasis on Amonkhet

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The car crashes into the oasis.
timeline.quote: An instant later, the ship hits the earth.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra wakes first, concussed, and checks on the others.
timeline.quote: Chandra's the first one to wake beneath the warm sun of Amonkhet.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti concludes the engine is blown and they must improvise from scrap.
timeline.quote: I regret to inform you we've blown the engine.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Loot encourages Chandra that when you see something wrong you fix it.
timeline.quote: When you see things that are wrong, you fix them.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Vraska says they promised to keep Loot safe.
timeline.quote: We promised to keep him safe.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia hot-wires the cobbled-together car.
timeline.quote: Pia's rubbing two wires together beneath the steering wheel.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra realizes Winter used Loot to find secret Omenpaths as shortcuts.
timeline.quote: He made you show him where the other Omenpaths are, the ones nobody else knows about.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Falling toward Ghirapur, Chandra sees the crowd panicking instead of celebrating.
timeline.quote: But as she realizes that the masses below are not celebrating but panicking, a different feeling takes hold.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra lands in a cart of racing-team plush toys.
timeline.quote: She lands in a cart of plush toys themed after each of the racing teams.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Jace raises a hand and Loot's eyes go blank.
timeline.quote: Jace raises a hand, and the little guy's eyes go blank.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra refuses to hand Loot over to Jace.
timeline.quote: I told Loot I would look after him,

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti sends drones to scout and Loot wakes from Jace's control.
timeline.quote: Even Loot's woken up

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Jace picks up the little creature from Chandra's crumpled form.
timeline.quote: He watches as Jace picks up something from Chandra's crumpled form—a little creature of some kind.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Nissa sees Jace scoop up the limp creature.
timeline.quote: She turns to see Jace scooping up a limp, small creature.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Jace calls Vraska away, leaving with Loot.
timeline.quote: We're leaving, Vraska,

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Loot they will make an entrance, and soon regrets it.
timeline.quote: In less than fifteen minutes, she came to regret those words.

citation.text: Count on Luck (Aetherdrift, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Loot is rescued by new rescuers he prefers.
timeline.quote: Loot decided he liked these rescuers much more than the last ones.

citation.text: Explosive Getaway (Aetherdrift, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Rocketeers use Daretti as a decoy; he is taken to a saurid village and imprisoned with Loot to be sacrificed.
timeline.quote: He was taken to a saurid village and imprisoned alongside Loot to be offered as a sacrifice.

citation.text: "Daretti", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Pia Nalaar rescue Daretti and Loot; Daretti patches his car and Chandra drives it away.
timeline.quote: Daretti quickly patched together his car, and Chandra drove it away from the village.
